headline: Luis María Urriza Assumes Presidency of Maizar, Calls for Investment Rules
summary: Former agriculture official Luis María Urriza has taken over the presidency of Maizar, succeeding Federico Zerboni and calling for clear rules to encourage investment.
why: Agricultural industry associations represent key commodity producers and influence policy discussions affecting agribusiness investments.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Leadership changes in agricultural associations can influence lobbying and sector regulations.
